tools.name: build_itinerary
tools.description: Draft a night out in one city as an ordered list of stops, each with why it is there and how to book it. READ-ONLY: this returns a plan, it does not save anything. To keep it, the user saves it themselves at /trip.html.

stops.description: Ordered venue ids from search_venues. 2-5 works best.

tools.name: find_open_tonight
tools.description: Find venues worth going to TONIGHT in a city — the ones with a happy hour or a late kitchen, best score first. This is the same definition the site's own "tonight" strip uses, so the agent and the page agree.

query.description: Optional single keyword to narrow the candidates.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 5, capped at 25.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Get the reservation platform (Resy, OpenTable, SevenRooms, Tock, walk-in) and, where available, the direct booking URL for one venue — so you can present it to the user. Returns the link; it does not open it and it never books anything.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get the full Dim Hour record for one venue: hours, phone, address, cuisine, neighborhood, score, awards, and how to book it. Takes the numeric id from search_venues.

city.description: City key the venue belongs to.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search Dim Hour's curated catalog of restaurants and bars across 24 cities. Query terms are matched individually, so ONE strong keyword ("omakase", "patio", "natural wine") works far better than a sentence. Omit city to search everywhere. Returns venues with their numeric id, which get_venue and get_booking_link take.

query.description: One strong keyword. Not a sentence.

city.description: City key, e.g. dallas, nyc, sf. Omit to search all cities.
